# Research

Studies of primary sources, one note per study, in the order they were done. Each note gives its research date at the top and is not rewritten later: redoing a study writes a new note.

- [0001 How agent frameworks model one run of an agent](0001-agent-session.md) - sessions, runs and threads in the nine sources, and their status values against ZeroSDK's nine (2026-10-20).
- [0002 How ZeroSDK can drive agent CLIs](0002-harness-bridge.md) - the harness and bridge contracts, herdr and cmux, and Claude Code on the CLI and SDK routes (2026-10-20).
- [0003 Where ZeroSDK's local, dynamic data can live](0003-local-data.md) - local stores, sync engines, TanStack DB and throwaway databases (2026-10-20).
